approved_command_preview: Harden v36 coordinated repair critique to use a fixed independent frontier model family rather than OpenRouter Auto, extend the v36 selftest, validate, and commit the bounded source/test delta to main.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$patcher = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'patch_v36_frontier_critic.py'
@'
from pathlib import Path

source_path = Path('.github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36.py')
text = source_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old = 'import ast\nimport json\n'
new = 'import ast\nimport copy\nimport json\n'
assert text.count(old) == 1, 'unexpected v36 import shape'
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
marker = 'def _repair_author_prompt(\n'
assert text.count(marker) == 1, 'unexpected repair author prompt marker count'
helper = '''def _repair_critic_config(config: Any, author_model: str) -> Any:
    """Choose a fixed frontier critic from a different model family than the author."""
    critic_config = copy.copy(config)
    served_author = str(author_model or "").strip().lower()
    if served_author.startswith("openai/"):
        critic_model = "anthropic/claude-opus-5"
    else:
        critic_model = "openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro"
    if hasattr(critic_config, "model"):
        critic_config.model = critic_model
    if hasattr(critic_config, "model_stack"):
        critic_config.model_stack = [critic_model]
    return critic_config


'''
text = text.replace(marker, helper + marker, 1)
old = '    critic_config = v25._independent_config(config)\n'
new = '    critic_config = _repair_critic_config(config, author_model)\n'
assert text.count(old) == 1, 'unexpected v36 critic config call count'
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
source_path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')

test_path = Path('.github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36_selftest.py')
test = test_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
marker = '    assert v36.REPAIR_SET_AUTHOR_SCHEMA["properties"]["edits"]["maxItems"] >= 3\n'
assert test.count(marker) == 1, 'unexpected v36 selftest insertion marker count'
addition = marker + '    critic_after_opus = v36._repair_critic_config(config, "anthropic/claude-opus-5")\n    assert critic_after_opus.model_stack == ["openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro"]\n    assert critic_after_opus.model == "openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro"\n    critic_after_sol = v36._repair_critic_config(config, "openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro")\n    assert critic_after_sol.model_stack == ["anthropic/claude-opus-5"]\n    assert critic_after_sol.model == "anthropic/claude-opus-5"\n    assert config.model_stack[0] == "anthropic/claude-opus-5"  # shared config was not mutated\n'
test = test.replace(marker, addition, 1)
test_path.write_text(test, encoding='utf-8')
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $patcher -Encoding utf8
python $patcher
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'v36 frontier critic patch failed' }
git diff --check -- .github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36.py .github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git diff --check failed' }
python -m py_compile .github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36.py .github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'py_compile failed' }
python .github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'v36 selftest failed' }
git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
git add -- .github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36.py .github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review_required_runtime_patch_v36_selftest.py
git commit -m 'DCOIR v36: use independent frontier repair critic (#456)'
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'commit failed' }
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'push failed' }
Write-Host 'DCOIR v36 frontier critic hardening committed and pushed'
